title: Apple : Finds Faulty Logic Boards in Small Number of iPhone 8s | MarketScreener
text:
By Josh Beckerman
Apple Inc. (AAPL) said a "very small percentage" of iPhone 8 devices have logic boards with a manufacturing defect that could cause unexpected restarts or frozen screens.
The company said the affected products were sold between September 2017 and March 2018 in the U.S., China, Hong Kong, Australia, India, Japan, Macau and New Zealand. It will provide free repairs for eligible devices.
Apple said the issue doesn't involve iPhone 8 Plus models or other iPhones.
